scope: Audit the exact existing responsive Trial and Gate review surfaces, same-BFF capability checks, Project-first authority, private attachment flow, issue capture and scan-entry primitives before defining any P7-08 product change.

Freeze a mobile field-action boundary in which phone and tablet layouts may prepare only actions already authorized by the same desktop BFF command, permission, CSRF, optimistic-conflict, audit and idempotency contracts.

Freeze photo evidence as the existing bounded private upload and clean File Revision bind flow with explicit local, pending, clean, failed, permission-unavailable and retry states and no raw private File URL.

Freeze scan entry as constrained data-entry assistance with visible parsed values and explicit user review before an existing command; scanning never creates authority, bypasses validation or silently submits.
Keep complex engineering comparison, parameter, dimension, source-manifest and controlled-output tables desktop-only while providing an honest mobile summary and deliberate desktop handoff.

Define the minimum complete vertical slice, ownership, responsive breakpoints, accessibility, trilingual coverage, affected tests, migration impact, rollback and final Phase 7 Level 3 boundary before product code.
non_scope: Product implementation before the P7-08 Requirement/domain/existing-capability audit and frozen plan pass.

Any new mobile-only role, permission, status transition, approval, Gate decision, Trial conclusion, upload bypass, raw File URL, offline sync, background queue, native application, device management or production integration authority.

Rendering complex engineering tables as compressed or horizontally unusable phone controls, or hiding critical blockers, exact versions, conflicts, held authority or unavailable external truth to fit a small screen.
Automatic submission from camera, barcode or QR input; caller-supplied actor, tenant, Project authority, immutable source hash, audit identity, external result or translated enum.
Phase 8 ERPNext integration, generic DocType CRUD, Frappe or ERPNext core patches, production ERPNext access, test deletion or threshold reduction.

expected_state.controller_marker: P7-07 Level 2 PASS; P7-08 audit active

rollback.before_product_resume: Restore the exact P7-07 final product checkpoint and retain its immutable Trial summary and controlled-output history; the P7-08 audit and controller transition contain no product mutation.
rollback.after_product_resume: Disable only the independent P7-08 mobile entry surfaces and deliver a reviewed forward repair while preserving every existing Project, Gate, Trial, issue, attachment, receipt, audit and immutable source record.
